method.timer_includes: record generation, list materialization where required, encoding, uninstrumented real file writes and flush
method.timer_excludes: imports, opening output file, complete output hashing and source receipts
method.peak_rss: complete fresh-process high-water mark sampled before output verification; no baseline subtraction
method.reference: independent parent stdlib per-row encoder plus literal array framing; exact complete byte count and SHA256
method.write_instrumentation: separate fresh diagnostic processes only; ordinary timing/RSS samples use actual file handles with no write wrappers. Diagnostics count calls, first complete record and maximum request; their elapsed time is never used for primary speed ratios
method.filesystem: buffered real files, OS cache uncontrolled, no fsync

publication_metadata_normalization.note: Machine-specific directory prefixes removed from origin labels; all measurements and captured source digests retained.
